digest.component_or_area: MCP HTTP service on AWS box (Gerrit + review-bot + opcert)
propositions: Enable a self-contained rebar MCP HTTP server on AWS that exposes all rebar operations through nginx /mcp/ TLS edge with static-bearer authentication, using per-client bearer PATs verified against official client documentation

Replace the review-bot stop-and-drain auto-update pattern with blue-green immutable-release for MCP (atomic upstream flip, retire-when-idle) to prevent saturation kills of in-flight certified operations

Provision the MCP container to sign plan-review and completion-verifier certificates under the existing opcert environment (9f1c8e42-7a3b-4d5e-b6c1-2f0a9d8e7c65) and prove the enforcement mechanism via fixture-config testing
Configure copilot, codex, and claude clients with static-bearer credentials to connect to the MCP server via committed configuration templates with per-client bearer PATs materialized from SSM
Update guidance and documentation to establish MCP-only policy for remote rebar operations and correct certified-op wording to reflect code-review via Gerrit LLM-Review (not op-cert)
